outcome: incidental finding of uterine gastrointestinal stromal tumor (GIST)
cohort: A 32-year-old pregnant lady undergoing an emergency caesarean section.
finding: An asymptomatic uterine gastrointestinal stromal tumor (GIST) was incidentally found during an emergency cesarean section in a 32-year-old lady, a presentation previously unreported.
mod_finding: The uterine GIST was an incidental finding discovered during an emergency caesarean section.
